SELECT COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sis.student_id) FROM student_internship_status sis WHERE sis.position_id = p.id AND sis.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND COALESCE(sis.recall_status, 0) != 2), 0) AS recruited_count, GREATEST(p.planned_recruit - COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sis.student_id) FROM student_internship_status sis WHERE sis.position_id = p.id AND sis.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND COALESCE(sis.recall_status, 0) != 2), 0), 0) AS remaining_quota, p.*, cu.company_name, pc.name AS category_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM position published WHERE published.company_id = p.company_id AND published.status IN ('active', 'paused')) AS company_position_count,
FROM position p JOIN company_users cu ON cu.id = p.company_id LEFT JOIN position_category pc ON pc.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN company_contact cc ON p.contact_id = cc.id AND cc.company_id = p.company_id WHERE p.status IN ('active', 'paused')
